---
title: "Milestone columns of the flight list"
description: "How the flight list takes its take-off and landing times, block times, runways, stands and distance-circle times from the flight events."
---

## In one sentence

The milestone columns put the main events of a flight on its flight-list row,
taken from the events of the same track at the row's own departure and
destination airports.

## What it needs

- The flight events of the track (see each event's page).
- The departure and destination airports of the row, after the correction by
  runway events (see [Departure and destination airports](airports.qmd)).

## How it is computed

1. **Take-off and landing.** `atot` is the earliest `ATOT` event at the
   departure airport, and `rwy_dep` and `rwy_dep_bearing_deg` the runway and
   its bearing from the same event. `aldt` is the latest `ALDT` at the
   destination airport, with `rwy_arr` and `rwy_arr_bearing_deg`.
2. **Block times.** `aobt` is the latest `AOBT` at the departure airport that
   is not after `atot`; `aibt` the earliest `AIBT` at the destination airport
   that is not before `aldt`.
3. **Stands.** `stnd_dep` is the stand named by that `AOBT`, otherwise the
   stand of the last `exit-parking_position` at the departure airport before
   `atot`. `stnd_arr` is the stand named by that `AIBT`, otherwise that of the
   first `entry-parking_position` at the destination airport after `aldt`.
4. **Distance circles.** For each radius (40, 50, 60, 100, 110 and 120 NM),
   `c{radius}_dep` is the first outbound crossing around the departure
   airport after `atot`, and `c{radius}_arr` the last inbound crossing around
   the destination airport before `aldt`.
5. Where the take-off or landing time is unknown, the time limit of steps 2
   to 4 is not applied. An event that names no airport is accepted. A column
   is empty when no event qualifies.

## Based on

Developed for OPDI. The events behind each column are described on their own
pages: [Take-off and landing times](take-off-landing.qmd),
[Off-block and in-block times](block-times.qmd),
[Airport surface events](surface-events.qmd) and
[Distance circle crossings](distance-rings.qmd).

## What is published

Flight list columns `atot`, `aldt`, `aobt`, `aibt`, `rwy_dep`,
`rwy_dep_bearing_deg`, `rwy_arr`, `rwy_arr_bearing_deg`, `stnd_dep`,
`stnd_arr`, `c40_arr`, `c50_arr`, `c60_arr`, `c100_arr`, `c110_arr`,
`c120_arr`, `c40_dep`, `c50_dep`, `c60_dep`, `c100_dep`, `c110_dep` and
`c120_dep`.

## Use cases

- **One row per flight**: taxi times, time in the air and time from the 40 NM
  circle to landing without reading the events file.
- **Runway and stand statistics per airport**, from `rwy_dep`, `rwy_arr`,
  `stnd_dep` and `stnd_arr`.

## Limitations

A column is only as available as its event, and on a track holding several
flights the events at the middle stop are not on the row. See
[Limitations: milestone columns](../limitations.qmd#lim-flight-list-milestones).

## Availability and accuracy

{{< include _generated/figures_flight-list-milestones.md >}}

The runway and stand comparisons count every recorded flight, so an empty
column counts against them. Per airport: see
[Accuracy and availability](../accuracy/index.qmd).
